notes: BackOtter's KVM test hosts, one row each: the one table the test scripts take their host names, ssh targets, slot and port ranges, classes, roles and defaults from (testvm/test2/t2lib/hosts.py reads it; testvm/hosts.sh is the shell's reader; the scripts find it relative to themselves, here on the Mac and in ~/backotter-work/testvm on the hosts). Order matters: lists keep it, and the first fleet host holds vm-update's fleet lock. enabled false: a row reserved for a host that does not exist yet (its name and ranges are taken), which no script treats as a host. default true: a host of every run without --hosts (t2, drive.py); a host joins the defaults only after HostTest2 and one representative per family pass on it (docs/design/test2/design-classes.md). slot_range: the host's guest-slot range (guest-slot.sh's slot_range_here; run-all.sh's PORT_BASE is its first port, GUEST_PORTS the range); stic_ports: drive.py's check ports, inside it. ip: an address for when mDNS fails, with host_key_alias the name known_hosts pins it under (null: none known). A host's limits (limits: what each is, and its default) are its row's fields of those names, else class_limits' for its class, else the defaults, the values every host had before; the small class sets stic_slots 2, holt_jobs 1 and base_gib 4 (the user's choice, 2026-11-13); the big hosts keep the defaults but bs2_slots, 5 (small 2); chopin and cinqcent set holt_disk_mode true (the user's choice, 2026-11-14, for vanilla3's 30 GiB disk). arch: the host's architecture, amd64 or arm64, amd64 when absent (every host before 2026-11-14): a guest runs only on a host of its own (a guest named *-arm64 is arm64, every other amd64; hosts.py guest_arch), and the x86-only loops (bs2, bko-holt shipping, build-round.sh's and promote-bins.sh's default hosts) take only amd64 hosts. job_slice: a systemd slice every heavy job on the host runs in (a guest's QEMU, cmp-run.sh's work), started by hosts.py job_prefix's sudo -n systemd-run --scope --quiet --slice=SLICE -- setpriv --reuid=USER --regid=USER --init-groups --reset-env -- CMD; vm-run and cmp-run.sh do it themselves; absent or null: none. bigfoot: the ARM64 host (docs/design/arm64.md), the user's daily machine, in bko.slice; it has no build, fleet, cache or store-mirror role, and it is also vm-store's master, which only Chopin (bigfoot-link) talks to, by its own name in vm-store (not this row).

classes.big: 62 GiB, a 30G RAM disk (cmp-run.sh ceiling about 23 GiB), host ZFS; build hosts
classes.small: 27 GiB, a 10G RAM disk (cmp-run.sh ceiling 9.0 9.2), no host ZFS; guests from the image cache

roles.build: builds a round's binaries (stick/build-round.sh) and bko-holt
roles.fleet: holds every guest; vm-update keeps the fleet's copies alike
roles.bigfoot-link: the one host that talks to Bigfoot (vm-store push)

limits.stic_slots: SticTest's checks at once on the host (drive.py --slots); default 3
limits.guest_slots: guest slots drive.py counts on the host's range, 1-3 (check.sh's slot_take 3); default 3
limits.holt_jobs: HoltTest jobs at once on the host (ht1-queue.sh's MAXJOBS); default 3
limits.base_gib: cmp-run.sh's BASE_GIB on the host, GiB kept for the system (BASE_GIB in the environment wins); default 6
limits.holt_disk_mode: true: a holt line over the host's RAM-disk ceiling whose memory fits runs on /bkoscratch (HT_RAM=0, --reserve 0 M; NVMe wear), and placement checks its memory only (not +img: ht1.sh runs it only in the RAM disk); default false
limits.bs2_slots: BackShot2's tier 1 and 2 cases at once on the host (bs2-host queue --slots, each under cmp-run.sh --reserve 2 3), 1-6: the queue's ports are 2943-2948, 2949 a by-hand tier 1's; default 3. big 5: fits cmp-run.sh's memory check (5 x 3 GiB of about 23), unmeasured (2026-11-13); small 2, as bs2 had
